user.title: Nida
user.description:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

**Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh** 🌙

Welcome to **Nida** for Home Assistant — a complete and customizable Islamic prayer companion for your smart home.

May Allah ﷺ accept your prayers and make this integration a means of khayr (goodness) in your household.

---

🕌 Location-based prayer times via the AlAdhan API
🔔 Pre-adhan reminders with sound and spoken message
🌅 Dedicated Fajr adhan
📢 Adhan for all prayers with day and night volume
📱 Device notifications to mobile and speakers
🌙 Ramadan features — Suhoor alarm and Tarhim
📅 Hijri calendar with Islamic holidays

---

May Allah reward the team at aladhan.com abundantly. Ameen. 🤲

— Iftikhar Farzan Izz Al Din Muhsin

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Nida instance can be configured.
